name: Erin Woods

queries.query: Erin Woods Calgary official parcel cadastral map GIS open data
queries.result: Official City of Calgary results identified the Erin Woods community profile, the City Ownership Parcel Fabric description, and the public Current Year Property Assessments (Parcel) dataset. The live Socrata endpoint returned three Erin Woods parcel geometries when filtered by community name.

queries.language: French (Canada; second official language; no separate local Calgary-language parcel service found)
queries.query: site:calgary.ca Erin Woods parcelles cadastrales Calgary données ouvertes
queries.result: First-party search returned the same City of Calgary Ownership Parcel Fabric and public parcel-assessment materials; no French-language local parcel viewer or separate French API was identified. The English City service is the applicable local source for Calgary.

registryBasis: The City of Calgary is evidenced as the local parcel-fabric custodian; its official OPF page states that the fabric represents registered titled and approved-tentative parcels within Calgary city limits and is derived from Legal Survey Fabric plus Alberta Land Titles instruments.

officialSources.observation: Official OPF documentation describes parcel shapes and related base fields for Calgary city limits. The product is distributed through City Online and is not an unrestricted direct download from the OPF page.

officialSources.publisher: The City of Calgary Open Data
officialSources.observation: The current parcel-assessment dataset states that its properties are Calgary lands with a registered parcel at Alberta Land Titles Office; dataset metadata identifies multipolygon geometry and the public page documents EPSG:4326 WGS84.
Official community profile confirms Erin Woods as a Calgary community and provides local community context; it is not itself a parcel geometry service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Citywide registered parcel assessment records, subject to the dataset exclusions documented by Calgary Open Data.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three bounded records matched the Erin Woods community-name filter; this is not a complete community extract or proof of citywide parcel coverage for every parcel type.

safeFieldAllowlist: cpid as stable native parcel identity

nativeFieldsObserved.reason: The public dataset exposes assessment, address, legal and account fields; those were not requested in the bounded response or retained in the sample.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Research verified a public geometry response, but packet completion is not source integration or adapter admission; independent serial qualification remains required.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point retained exactly in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment was made to obtain a parcel hit.
